statements.text: Mr. Speaker, finally, I include in the Record an article from StateScoop with a letter from Al Sharpton of the National Action Network, outlining many issues involved in identity verification done by artificial intelligence. [...] AI-driven risk models are only as fair as the data on which they are trained, and the commercial and alternative data underlying these systems systematically underrepresent and misrepresent communities of color. [...] those structural gaps are not corrected by the algorithm, they are encoded into it.
statements.context: Floor remarks by Rep. Bobby Scott of Virginia inserting into the Congressional Record a StateScoop article and a letter from Rev. Al Sharpton regarding AI-powered identity-verification vendor Socure.
